sql:
-- Final verification query
WITH alive_patients AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient`
  WHERE deceased.dateTime IS NULL
),
patients_with_diagnosis AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT subject.patientId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition`
  WHERE code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code IN ('44054006', '38341003')
    AND subject.patientId IS NOT NULL
),
patients_with_med_count AS (
  SELECT subject.patientId,
         COUNT(DISTINCT medication.codeableConcept.text) as med_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request`
  WHERE status = 'active'
    AND subject.patientId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY subject.patientId
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT medication.codeableConcept.text) >= 7
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as patient_count
FROM alive_patients ap
JOIN patients_with_diagnosis pmd ON ap.id = pmd.patientId
JOIN patients_with_med_count pmc ON ap.id = pmc.patientId
